name: Mail Server
description: Complete mail server: responsive webmail (filters, blocked senders, templates, scheduled send, auto-forward) and a server console (mailboxes and quotas, aliases, outbound queue, policies) on a real MTA with DKIM/SPF/DNS tooling
author: WordJS

accountCapabilities.name: Professional mail account
accountCapabilities.description: A mailbox on the site’s mail domain: this account can read and send mail from this server and receives the mail addressed to its account email. While it is on, only an administrator can change that address.

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its admin page and its admin UI extension (a hooks bundle loaded on every admin page). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
Read non-secret site info (URL/domain/admin email) via the safe site bridge to resolve sender identity and local delivery domain.
Persist non-secret SMTP/display settings (from name/email, HELO host, security toggles) via the options bridge.
Read the plugin's own wjp_mail_server_* tables (mailboxes, attachments, secrets).
Create and write the plugin's own wjp_mail_server_* tables (mailboxes, attachments, secrets).
Admin-only mail operations (settings, DKIM key generation, delivery tests).
Register this plugin as the host-wide outbound mail provider (wordjs.provideMail).
Alert users in real-time about new inbound/internal emails and delivery failures.
Register an 'email' notification transport so other plugins can deliver notifications by email.
Read email attachments and the Bayes classifier from the plugin's own directory.
Store email attachments and persist the Bayes classifier in the plugin's own directory.
Resolve local recipients/senders via the safe users projection (never password hashes) for internal delivery and notifications.

Resolve MX records and the TXT records that authenticate inbound mail (SPF, DKIM keys, DMARC policies) over the host DNS bridge, and deliver mail directly to remote MTAs / a configured relay (NET/TLS) on the SMTP ports 25, 465, 587 and 2525.

Receive email from the internet: WordJS opens SMTP port 25 for this plugin and hands it each incoming message, which it filters (SPF, DNSBL, spam) and delivers to the right mailbox. Only one plugin can hold this permission.
Expose the webmail admin API (mailboxes, messages, attachments, DKIM/DNS tooling) and the endpoints the admin page calls.
Add the Email Settings entry to the admin sidebar.
